notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: Go round Delhi, not through it
notes.text: Delhi has answered neither your transfer request nor your follow-up, and Jakarta is short-handed until 16 November. INSEAD's own immigration officer, Amanda Heurteau, takes one-to-one calls and puts the long-stay visa at seven to eight weeks against a 3 January start. - Book that call this week rather than waiting on Delhi.
